name: One Irvine Workforce Youth Service Corps Summer High School Program
what_you_do: High school students work as Community Services Leaders. You help with summer camps, art programs, events and park setup. You also get job and leadership training.
who_can_apply: High school students of all backgrounds can apply. Irvine residents get priority. Priority also goes to youth who are low-income or out of school. It also goes to youth in foster care and first-generation college students.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated on the program page. The page calls the roles jobs ("hiring").
duration: About 20 hours a week. Shifts run 7 a.m. to 10 p.m., weekdays and weekends.
deadline_text: The page gives no closing date. It says to check back in February 2027.
how_to_apply: The page gives no application link or contact for this summer program. It says to check back in February 2027.
notes: This program is part of a California Volunteers Youth Service Corps grant. The same page lists an adult job program for ages 18 to 30. That one is not for high school students. Training covers job search, interviewing, leadership, customer service and financial literacy.
